exposure: uterine artery embolization (UAE) combined with curettage
outcome: Time to β-human chorionic gonadotropin (β-hCG) concentration return to normal
finding: UAE combined with curettage was associated with significantly lower blood loss, shorter time to β-hCG normalization, shorter hospitalization duration, and lower percentage of side effects compared to MTX plus curettage in the treatment of CSP.
